ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in lobe centers and 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at trailing edges and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation band along the trailing edge and median notch. High-density distribution of discrete circular black blobs clustered at the distal 1/3 of both lobes. Solid white pixel field in the proximal and central regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 50 degrees; vertical depth is significant, dividing the lobes cleanly.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations along the full trailing edge with variable pixel-amplitude; most pronounced jaggedness on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-tilted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive clusters of circular low-intensity spots on high-intensity white background; high density on right lobe distal region and left lobe upper margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct dark linear mark on the inner left lobe oriented diagonally towards the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense cluster of dark irregular markings on both tips; potential parasitic or barnacle scarring history.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, large-diameter circular mottling pattern distributed symmetrically across distal lobe surfaces.
